title: Action-only goal-bearing diffusion: joint-state simplification of A3
coverage_gap: N10 lacks off-diagonal layout training and the designated extrapolation ranges. Development feedback localizes A1's shortcomings to LH (C 6/10, E 0/5) and A2's to both off-diagonal E cells (0/5 each), while A3 succeeded in every C and E cell. Those are aggregate outcomes, not observations of failure trajectories. The available comparison does not establish whether A3's goal-bearing frame, its joint future-state diffusion, or their interaction caused the advantage.
reusable_regularity: Retain exactly A3's 48-dimensional causal metric conditioning, world dependencies, and fixed chunk-start goal-bearing yaw frame, but diffuse action4 alone. The hypothesis is that canonicalizing the large lateral bearing variation carries enough reusable structure for independent peg/box placement, and that jointly generating seven future contact-state channels may be unnecessary. This is one focused latent-formulation simplification, not a new rollout controller, checkpoint choice, or search. It offers a small parameter/compute reduction if success is retained; latency must still be measured by the fixed method.
dependencies_preserved: distinct hand-to-pegGrasp and pegHead-to-goal edges with signed metric and smooth fine coordinates; the head-to-grasp offset is retained
absolute world hand, causal frame orientation, goal-to-hand relation and object rotation columns preserve robot/workspace and side-opening orientation dependencies
both whole causal observations, native previous hand/object motion and previous orientation retain dynamics; gripper aperture/change retains contact information
world up and all four relevant z heights preserve gravity, table and elevated-hole relations
the frame is exactly the A3 proper horizontal rotation, held constant for every action in each chunk; the scalar gripper is not rotated
no contact-state predictions substitute for measured geometry, and no scripted action or collision-free path is introduced

expected_failure_signature: If A3's generated contact-state trajectory was essential, A4 should lose success particularly on off-diagonal E transfers, with grasp/transport consistency a plausible but unobserved mechanism. A degradation would reject the claim that frame canonicalization alone suffices; it would not by itself identify a particular physical failure stage. If success is retained, the simplification supports omitting joint states at this evidence budget, not a claim of universal equivalence. Rapid near-goal bearing changes and missed-grasp recovery remain inherited risks. No A3 development failure is invented, and no A4 performance has been measured at design time.

required_runtime_fields.source: causal_context.raw_history [B,2,42] plus raw_current [B,42] for the chunk frame; identical sources and feature order to A3
required_runtime_fields.omitted: Declared absent object2 zero fields only. No stage oracle, future observation/action, factor value, demonstration identity, episode clock, simulator model or success flag.
required_runtime_fields.frame_definition: At chunk start e1_xy=normalize(goal_xy-pegHead_xy), e2_xy=(-e1_y,e1_x), e3=world z. If bearing length is at most 0.0001 m, use the measured head-minus-grasp horizontal axis; if that too is degenerate use (-1,0). The same causal frame serves both history observations and all sixteen actions.
required_runtime_fields.action_frame: Encode xyz with R^T and decode xyz with R, preserving native 0.01 m-per-unit world displacement semantics. Gripper passes through unchanged. No action translation, gain, saturation or clipping is added; the host alone clips the decoded native cube and executes the common four-action prefix.

support_fit: None. A3's fixed metric scales are unchanged. Host normalization and data remain frozen, and no trained A1-A3 weights or deployment state are loaded.
change_summary: One revision slot based on completed development feedback. Preserve A3 conditioning/frame code and all metric constants. Reduce diffusion_action_dim from 11 to 4; remove future_contact_world labels, seven appended clean targets, and the 0.15-weight separately normalized joint-state loss. Thus the common action epsilon objective is the sole loss, still weight 1 with denominator mask.sum()*4. Remove the now-unused numpy import and joint_aux_weight config. No other architectural, temporal, control, normalization, optimizer or budget changes; all modules train anew. This compares complete design formulations, whose different channel shapes also entail the host's corresponding initialization/noise tensor shapes.
